create_PoseDataset: create a PoseDataset from a DictConfig to load tactile images and discretized pose labels for a finger type
discretize_poses_PoseDataset: discretize continuous 6D poses into bin-based class labels for translation X, Y and rotation Yaw
get_item_PoseDataset: get a sample from the PoseDataset returning tactile images and pose labels for a given index
get_tactile_images_PoseDataset: get tactile images for a sample index formatted as video, concatenated channels, or single image
plot_tactile_clip_PoseDataset: plot and save a tactile image clip as a PNG figure for debugging purposes
